SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for session security. Auto-generated during install.

PAPERLESS_REDIS.description: Redis connection URL for the Celery task queue.

PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER.description: Username for the initial admin account.

PAPERLESS_TIME_ZONE.description: Timezone for date display and scheduling (e.g. America/New_York).
